steps.guidance: Set some basic parameters, such as Base_url, username and password
Call /v1/cl/user/login with signature, which should be calculated with password and something else
Call /v1/cl/network/list to search all network neighbors and extract the default network neighbor. Output its network_id.

output.name: network_id
output.description: Default network neighbor ID extracted from response

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/network/fetch with network_id to retrieve full configuration, including ipv4_static_host_list.

input.name: network_id
input.description: ID of the network to fetch

output.name: ipv4_static_host_list
output.description: Static IPv4 hosts returned by the API

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/network/tags/fetch with network_id to retrieve component tags.

input.name: network_id
input.description: Network ID whose component tags will be fetched

output.name: component_tags
output.description: List of component tags associated with the given network

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/component/create with type=2 to create a DDoS component. Extract returned configuration parameters.

input.name: type
input.description: Component type; 2 represents DDoS attack component

output.name: ddos_attack_component_config
output.description: The detailed configuration information for the ddos_attack component includes the following sections:'basic','load_profile','attack_profile','data_rate','super_flow','src_port','delay_start','clean_duration'

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/profile/list to retrieve all attack profiles, then Select an attack profile from the returned results that matches or contains the attack_name. Output profile_id and profile_name.

input.name: attack_name
input.description: keyword to identify the required attack profile

output.name: profile_id
output.description: ID of the attack profile matching the test requirement

output.name: profile_name
output.description: Name of the matched attack profile

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/fetch with testcase_id to retrieve complete configuration parameters.

input.name: testcase_id
input.description: ID of the testcase to fetch

steps.description: Save testcase after modifying DDoS attack profile
steps.guidance: The parameters for the /v1/cl/testcase/save endpoint are formed by merging the testcase_config and ddos_attack_component_config objects, update the profile_id in ddos_attack_compoent_config. Output the new testcase_id.

input.name: ddos_attack_component_config
input.description: The detailed configuration information for the ddos_attack component includes the following sections: 'basic','load_profile','attack_profile','data_rate','super_flow','src_port','delay_start','clean_duration'

input.name: profile_id
input.description: DDoS attack profile ID used to update the testcase

output.name: testcase_id
output.description: ID of the saved or updated testcase

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/testcase/run with testcase_id and testcase_name to start executing the testcase.

input.name: testcase_id
input.description: ID of the testcase to run

steps.guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/logout with the current username (e.g., admin) to terminate the session.

input.name: USERNAME
input.description: Username to logout, such as admin

output.name: code
output.description: Returned logout result status, response code, zero for success, non-zero for errors
